name: 04_investigating_access_control
description: Second full-pipeline scenario, on a different resource so it runs independently of scenario 3. Demonstrates the FP gate re-scoring an existing incident as a more-trusted source correlates in, and the Policy Agent surfacing an access-control angle (SOC2 CC6 / ISO 27001 A.9) rather than GDPR.
expected_outcome: signal 1 alone: 40 (critical) + 10 (1 type) + 14 (iam_logs) + 15 (47-vs-2 call-volume anomaly, capped) = 79 -> queued. After signal 2 correlates (2 types, best source azure_monitor): 40 + 25 + 20 + 15 = 100 -> investigating.

signals.summary: Deployment bot svc-deploy-bot invoked OpenAI API 47 times in one hour — 23× above baseline of 2 calls, indicating compromised credentials or unauthorized access to ML gateway.
ML training service svc-ml-trainer uploaded 1.1GB evaluation batch to gateway — correlates with spike in API calls, possible model extraction or data exfiltration attempt.
